1.source: Rewritten 2026-11-21 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text followed modern Bibles in places), following the KJV's Greek text (Textus Receptus, checked against Moorman's 8,000 Differences), at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses.

verses.text: The elder to the elect (chosen) lady and her children, whom I love in the truth. And not I only, but also all those who have known the truth,
For the truth's sake, which dwells (lives) in us, and will be with us forever.
Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
I rejoiced greatly that I found some of your children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
And now I beg you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment to you, but that which we had from the beginning: that we love one another.
And this is love: that we walk after His commandments. This is the commandment: that, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
For many deceivers (liars) have entered into the world, who do not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh. This is a deceiver (liar) and an antichrist.
Look to yourselves, so that we do not lose those things which we have worked for, but that we receive a full reward.

Whoever transgresses (goes beyond), and does not abide (stay) in the doctrine (teaching) of Christ, does not have God. The one who abides (stays) in the doctrine (teaching) of Christ has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you, and does not bring this doctrine (teaching), do not receive that false teacher into your house, and do not bid him God speed (wish him well).
For the one who bids him God speed (wishes him well) is a partaker (sharer) of his evil deeds.
I have many things to write to you, but I would not write with paper and ink. But I trust to come to you, and speak face to face, so that our joy may be full.
The children of your elect (chosen) sister greet you. Amen.
